scope: First twelve risk-prioritized current approved portraits actually visually rechecked. All twelve individually show deletion of required original full backdrop and have manual rejected decisions queued for the sole producer. Earlier approvals preserved; this is not a retroactive claim they passed background preservation. Remaining screened sources are still pending manual recheck.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actually inspected this exact original and unchanged current raw output on white/cyan/alpha. The original retains a full near-opaque cream/grey painted background over the rectangle, whereas the output deletes that original background into transparent exterior around the figure. This is a source-content defect. Withdraw this current image qualification, preserve the earlier approval and all PNG bytes, and regenerate with the original full rectangular backdrop. Keep source garment/accessories, actual hair/facial hair, pose/expression/crop and compact fitted mascot anatomy. Numerical screening alone did not make this decision; the full paired pages were actually viewed.
